1.explanation: This minimal React example mounts a Carbon DataTable with the TableToolbar and TableToolbarSearch (the magnifying-glass icon). When you hover over the search icon, you will see the same misalignment as described in the bug report: the hover background is too tall and the icon sits low instead of being perfectly centered. Import the Carbon CSS and run this code in a create-react-app or Storybook environment with @carbon/react installed to reproduce the issue.
1.bug_scenario: On the DataTable “With filtering” example, when you hover over the search icon in the toolbar the gray hover background expands too far vertically, pushing the magnifying-glass icon off-center. The icon appears too low inside its hover box and looks misaligned.
